name: JV_ASSIGNMENT_RULES_B
description: This table contains assignment rules for each joint venture. These rules are used to assign ownership definitions or direct billed stakeholders to joint venture transactions to be distributed.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the assignment rule.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_RULE_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: The short name of the assignment rule that is used as an identifier.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_RULE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status code of the assignment rule. It is based on ORA_JV_ASSIGNMENT_RULE_STATUS lookup codes such as ORA_JV_EDITING, ORA_JV_ACTIVE, ORA_JV_INACTIVE, or other user defined values.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture that the assignment rule is associated with.

columns.name: OWNER_DEFINITION_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: The ownership definition short name to be assigned to joint venture transactions based on the assignment rule.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: The stakeholder to be assigned to joint venture transactions based on the assignment rule. This will be the direct billed stakeholder.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the account set used by the assignment rule to select joint venture transactions, which will be updated with an ownership definition or direct billed stakeholder.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the account to be used by the assignment rule to select joint venture transactions, which will be updated with an ownership definition or direct billed stakeholder.

columns.name: PROJECT_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the project set associated with the assignment rule.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Number assigned by the user to indicate the order assignment rules will be processed for the joint venture.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The beginning date for the assignment rule, which will be compared to the transaction date on joint venture transactions to determine which transactions will be updated with an ownership definition or direct billed stakeholder.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The ending date for the assignment rule, which will be compared to the transaction date on joint venture transactions to determine which transactions will be updated with an ownership definition or direct billed stakeholder.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
